method: Sum gross and scaled annulus counts across supported product livetime. Treat all gross counts as source for the one-sided exact Poisson upper bound. These are exposure-weighted mean detected aperture rates over separate observations; short peaks can be substantially brighter. Every single-visit test retains its original multiplicity across all supported products. Original Git blobs, exact archive directory listings and EVT2 download receipts are verified here. Compressed and decompressed EVT2 checksums identify the remote source bytes.
